name: com.passcustoms/mcp
title: PassCustoms — US Tariff, HTS & ECCN Compliance
description: 2026 US import tariffs (USITC HTS, Sec 301/232, USMCA), BIS ECCN/Schedule B & IEEPA duty refunds

tools.name: lookup_eccn_and_schedule_b
tools.description: Classify hardware, electronics, industrial parts, or commercial goods under U.S. BIS 15 CFR Part 774 (ECCN vs. EAR99, NLR / ENC license exception) and U.S. Census 10-digit Schedule B / HTS. Returns official citations plus a pre-filled PassCustoms.com link where the user can download a signed $19 Audit PDF.

description.description: Product name, datasheet specs, encryption details, or supplier quote.

tools.name: calculate_us_import_tariff_2026
tools.description: Calculate 2026 5-layer U.S. landed import duty across Column 1 MFN rates, Chapter 99 Section 301/232 surtaxes (post-Feb 2026 Supreme Court IEEPA repeal), CBP MPF/HMF, USMCA rules, and USPS / FedEx / DHL clearance fees. Returns full dollar breakdown plus a pre-filled PassCustoms.com calculator & $29 Excel Worksheet link.

hts_or_product.description: 10-digit U.S. HTS code, 6-digit HS prefix (e.g. '392690'), or plain-English product keyword.

origin_country.description: ISO-2 country of manufacture (CN, VN, MX, CA, DE, TW, JP, KR, IN, GB).

customs_value_usd.description: Commercial invoice customs value in USD.

claim_usmca_or_fta.description: True only if goods meet USMCA/FTA rules of origin with a signed Certificate of Origin.

tools.name: search_us_hts_10digit
tools.description: Search 1,510+ official 2026 USITC 10-digit Harmonized Tariff Schedule subheadings by 4/6-digit HS prefix or product keyword, returning Column 1 MFN duty rates and direct schedule links.

tools.name: get_ieepa_tariff_refund_guide
tools.description: Explain 2026 U.S. IEEPA tariff refund eligibility (invalidated Chapter 99 headings 9903.01 / 9903.02 vs. still-active Section 301 9903.88 and Section 232 9903.80/85) and provide direct links to PassCustoms's 100% local-browser CBP ACE ES-003 and FedEx/DHL refund parsers.
